plugins.description: Direct CSV import, smoothing, ring-background compensation, 2D/3D visualization, Excel reports and improved start controls.

plugins.description: SWV and DPV concentration series with interactive 3D waterfall plots, cursor-defined peak integration and calibration.

plugins.description: Au/Ag Raman characterization before and after electrochemical activation, including apparent Raman enhancement, peak shifts and optional activation-CV analysis.
